hook: The waves were breaking right over him on the rocks.
narration: A wave broke right over this man, stranded on a Florida jetty.
This was the St. Lucie Inlet, on Florida's Atlantic coast, in December.
A Coast Guard helicopter from Air Station Miami came in low over the surf.
The pilot holds a steady hover while the swimmer rides the cable down to the rocks.
[short pause] The swimmer reached him as more waves rolled in behind them.
Then the cable lifted them both off the rocks.
outcome: The aircrew flew the man to Stuart Airport, with no medical concerns.
title: Waves hit him on a Florida jetty
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Miami MH-65 crew hoisted a man stranded on a jetty near St. Lucie Inlet, Florida, on Dec. 15, 2024, and brought him to Stuart Airport with no medical concerns.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video edited by Petty Officer 3rd Class Eric Rodriguez, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/947469/coast-guard-rescues-stranded-mariner-off-st-lucie-inlet-jetty
